parts.notes: Added so the 3D viewer can select this item on its own. Count is a placeholder until inventory confirms it.

parts.name: Right side cover
parts.notes: Added so the 3D viewer can select this item on its own. Count is a placeholder until inventory confirms it.

parts.name: Handlebar and clamps
parts.notes: Added so the 3D viewer can select this item on its own. Count is a placeholder until inventory confirms it.

tasks.title: Confirm model identity
tasks.instructions: Record frame/engine identifiers, market clues, model code and modifications; keep serial numbers private in public photos.
tasks.expected: Variant/market documented and checked against model-specific sources.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Variant/market documented and checked against model-specific sources.

tasks.title: Create photo folder structure
tasks.instructions: Create admin, inventory, engine, fuel, electrical, chassis, finish, assembly, testing, receipts and manuals folders.
tasks.expected: Folders accessible to team.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Folders accessible to team.

tasks.title: Photograph all parts before handling
tasks.instructions: Photograph trays, bags, assemblies, fasteners, labels, markings and original routing before cleaning.
tasks.expected: Every container and assembly has photo references.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Every container and assembly has photo references.

tasks.title: Set up work zones
tasks.instructions: Separate dirty work, clean assembly, electrical testing, chemicals and quarantined parts; prepare bins/PPE/fire safety.
tasks.expected: Zones and hazards reviewed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Zones and hazards reviewed.

tasks.title: Set base budget and contingency
tasks.instructions: Enter budget/contingency in Budget Ledger; agree purchase and machine-shop approval rules.
tasks.expected: Owner, contingency and approval threshold recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Owner, contingency and approval threshold recorded.

tasks.title: Assign inventory IDs to all items
tasks.instructions: Label each assembly, component, fastener group and consumable; record quantity and storage location.
tasks.expected: Every identified item has an ID, count and location.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Every identified item has an ID, count and location.

tasks.title: Count fasteners and spacers by group
tasks.instructions: Separate by location and type; do not assume similar-looking bolts are interchangeable.
tasks.reason: Small hardware is easy to lose.
tasks.expected: Counts and identification confidence recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Counts and identification confidence recorded.

tasks.title: Reconcile counts against verified fiche
tasks.instructions: Use exact variant diagrams and actual bike configuration; leave expected quantity blank until verified.
tasks.reason: Finds missing parts without invented counts.
tasks.expected: Discrepancies logged as issues/purchase needs.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Discrepancies logged as issues/purchase needs.

tasks.title: Triage component condition
tasks.instructions: Photograph before cleaning; classify serviceable, damaged, missing, uninspected and undecided.
tasks.expected: Major components have initial condition and disposition.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Major components have initial condition and disposition.

tasks.title: Obtain exact factory service manual
tasks.instructions: Confirm manual applicability to actual model/market/year; record edition, page and source.
tasks.expected: Manual applicability verified; technical references entered.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Manual applicability verified; technical references entered.

tasks.title: Obtain matching OEM parts fiche
tasks.instructions: Check model letter and serial breakpoints; distinguish GS750B from E/EC/N/EN variants.
tasks.expected: Matching fiche and variant confirmed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Matching fiche and variant confirmed.

tasks.title: Build repair forecast
tasks.instructions: Use inspection findings and quotes; retain unknowns as allowances, not fabricated prices.
tasks.expected: Budget and contingency approved.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Budget and contingency approved.

tasks.title: Verify fitment before ordering
tasks.instructions: Check part number, variant, dimensions, electrical load, mounting or documented physical test; save evidence.
tasks.expected: Fitment source recorded, especially safety-critical parts.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Fitment source recorded, especially safety-critical parts.

tasks.title: Clean parts in controlled batches
tasks.instructions: Photograph condition first; protect bearings, seals, wiring, oilways and machined surfaces from chemicals/abrasives.
tasks.expected: Clean enough to inspect; product/hazards recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Clean enough to inspect; product/hazards recorded.

tasks.title: Inspect frame and steering head
tasks.instructions: Check cracks, corrosion, impact damage and prior repairs; escalate structural concerns to a qualified specialist.
tasks.expected: No unresolved structural concern; evidence filed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No unresolved structural concern; evidence filed.

tasks.title: Inspect hoses, boots and rubber parts
tasks.instructions: Check cracks, hardening, swelling, distortion and date codes; decide repair/replacement.
tasks.reason: Old rubber can fail without warning.
tasks.expected: Each item disposition recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Each item disposition recorded.

tasks.title: Create measurement plan
tasks.instructions: For each inspection point, record tool, method, factory limit, units and source before measuring.
tasks.expected: Critical checks have verified limits or explicit blockers.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Critical checks have verified limits or explicit blockers.

tasks.title: Inspect engine externally
tasks.instructions: Check castings, mounts, plugs, covers, water ingress, impact marks and modifications before opening.
tasks.expected: Findings documented; issues logged.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Findings documented; issues logged.

tasks.title: Drain/inspect oil if present
tasks.instructions: Collect oil cleanly; record metal, water, sludge, fuel smell and quantity if known.
tasks.expected: Findings photographed and recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Findings photographed and recorded.

tasks.title: Separate installed-engine from teardown tests
tasks.instructions: Compression, running oil pressure, charging and running checks wait until engine is assembled; do not infer results now.
tasks.expected: Test plan distinguishes in-place checks from teardown-only checks.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Test plan distinguishes in-place checks from teardown-only checks.

tasks.title: Disassemble only as required
tasks.instructions: Use manual sequence; label shim, bearing, timing, fastener and component locations; photograph orientation.
tasks.expected: Every removed part is traceable.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Every removed part is traceable.

tasks.title: Inspect head, cam journals, valves and guides
tasks.instructions: Inspect cracks, scoring, burning, pitting, damaged threads and prior repairs; measure per manual.
tasks.expected: Measurements entered; machine-shop referral where needed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Measurements entered; machine-shop referral where needed.

tasks.title: Inspect cam chain, tensioner and guides
tasks.instructions: Measure/inspect wear, damage and function using factory criteria.
tasks.expected: All parts meet verified limits or replacement approved.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All parts meet verified limits or replacement approved.

tasks.title: Measure bore taper/out-of-round
tasks.instructions: Measure every cylinder at manual-specified heights and axes; record actual readings.
tasks.expected: Readings compared with verified limits; machine decision signed off.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Readings compared with verified limits; machine decision signed off.

tasks.title: Inspect pistons, rings, grooves and pins
tasks.instructions: Measure piston clearance and ring end gap per manual; keep parts paired by cylinder.
tasks.expected: Per-cylinder findings documented.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Per-cylinder findings documented.

tasks.title: Inspect crankshaft, rods and bearings
tasks.instructions: Measure journals/play and inspect discoloration, scoring and bearing identification.
tasks.expected: Measurements recorded; machine-shop review if uncertain.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Measurements recorded; machine-shop review if uncertain.

tasks.title: Inspect oil pump, sump, pickup and passages
tasks.instructions: Remove debris; protect oilways from lint/abrasive media; verify pump per manual.
tasks.expected: Oilways clean and pump disposition approved.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Oilways clean and pump disposition approved.

tasks.title: Inspect gears, dogs, shafts, forks and drum
tasks.instructions: Check chipped teeth, rounded dogs, scoring, bent forks and abnormal wear.
tasks.reason: Gear faults affect control and reliability.
tasks.expected: Every component disposition documented.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Every component disposition documented.

tasks.title: Inspect basket, plates, springs and hub
tasks.instructions: Measure wear, spring length and basket notching to manual.
tasks.expected: Measurements and replacement decisions recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Measurements and replacement decisions recorded.

tasks.title: Approve machine work after measurement
tasks.instructions: Get written estimate; confirm replacement part availability and dimensions before authorizing machining.
tasks.expected: Owner approves scope, cost and parts availability.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Owner approves scope, cost and parts availability.

tasks.title: Final-clean oilways and mating surfaces
tasks.instructions: Keep grit out of bearings and passages; inspect cleanliness under good light.
tasks.expected: Independent cleanliness check passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Independent cleanliness check passed.

tasks.title: Build engine bill of materials
tasks.instructions: Verify gaskets, seals, circlips, bearings, shims, fasteners and one-time-use items against fiche/manual.
tasks.expected: All required parts present and fitment verified.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All required parts present and fitment verified.

tasks.title: Assemble lower end/transmission
tasks.instructions: Follow sequence, bearing placement, clearances, sealant locations and verified torque values.
tasks.expected: Critical internal steps independently checked; torque/clearance evidence attached.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Critical internal steps independently checked; torque/clearance evidence attached.

tasks.title: Install pistons, cylinders and head
tasks.instructions: Use verified ring orientation, lubrication, gasket orientation and torque sequence.
tasks.expected: Fasteners and clearances documented; reviewer signs.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Fasteners and clearances documented; reviewer signs.

tasks.title: Set cam timing and rotate by hand
tasks.instructions: Follow exact timing marks/tensioner setup; rotate as specified and stop if interference is felt.
tasks.expected: Timing independently verified; no interference.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Timing independently verified; no interference.

tasks.title: Adjust valve clearances
tasks.instructions: Record every valve, initial clearance, shim and final clearance to exact manual specification.
tasks.expected: All final clearances within verified limits.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All final clearances within verified limits.

tasks.title: Lubrication and pre-install checks
tasks.instructions: Use model-specific priming procedure; verify plugs, covers, seals and hand rotation.
tasks.expected: Engine gate passed before installation.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Engine gate passed before installation.

tasks.title: Assess alignment and structural condition
tasks.instructions: Use qualified assessment for suspected damage or prior repairs.
tasks.expected: Frame accepted by qualified reviewer.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Frame accepted by qualified reviewer.

tasks.title: Inspect steering bearings/races
tasks.instructions: Check brinelling, corrosion, smooth movement, play and correct preload procedure.
tasks.expected: No notchiness/play; adjustment documented.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No notchiness/play; adjustment documented.

tasks.title: Inspect pivot and bushings
tasks.instructions: Check corrosion, play, wear, movement and alignment.
tasks.reason: Rear wheel control depends on sound pivots.
tasks.expected: No unacceptable play/damage.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No unacceptable play/damage.

tasks.title: Inspect tubes, seals, bushings and internals
tasks.instructions: Check straightness, pitting, wear, damping parts and oil procedure to manual.
tasks.expected: Measurements recorded; no leaks/binding after rebuild.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Measurements recorded; no leaks/binding after rebuild.

tasks.title: Inspect shocks and mounts
tasks.instructions: Check leaks, damping, springs, mounting eyes and secure fit.
tasks.expected: Repair/replace decision recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Repair/replace decision recorded.

tasks.title: Inspect rims/hubs and runout
tasks.instructions: Confirm wheel type; inspect cracks, corrosion, spokes if applicable and runout to manual.
tasks.expected: Verified limits met or specialist repair approved.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Verified limits met or specialist repair approved.

tasks.title: Inspect/replace wheel bearings and seals
tasks.instructions: Check roughness, play, corrosion, seals and spacer order.
tasks.reason: Bearing failure can cause loss of control.
tasks.expected: Correct parts/spacers installed; smooth rotation/no play.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Correct parts/spacers installed; smooth rotation/no play.

tasks.title: Verify tire compatibility and condition
tasks.instructions: Check size, load/speed rating, date, cracks, rim/tube compatibility and pressure source.
tasks.reason: Tires are the road contact patch.
tasks.expected: Compatibility and condition accepted; source recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Compatibility and condition accepted; source recorded.

tasks.title: Measure discs/drums and inspect hardware
tasks.instructions: Identify actual brake type; measure wear/runout and components against exact limits.
tasks.expected: All components within verified limits or replaced.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All components within verified limits or replaced.

tasks.title: Inspect/rebuild master cylinders and calipers
tasks.instructions: Inspect bores, pistons, seals, slides and hose age; use compatible parts/fluid.
tasks.reason: Hydraulic failure can cause loss of braking.
tasks.expected: No leaks, seized parts or damaged bores.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No leaks, seized parts or damaged bores.

tasks.title: Replace/verify hoses and bleed
tasks.instructions: Use correctly rated hoses/fittings and factory bleeding procedure.
tasks.reason: Old hoses can swell or rupture.
tasks.expected: Firm controls, no leaks, independent approval.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Firm controls, no leaks, independent approval.

tasks.title: Inspect chain and sprockets
tasks.instructions: Check wear, stiff links, hooked teeth, alignment and adjustment to verified spec.
tasks.expected: Condition and adjustment recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Condition and adjustment recorded.

tasks.title: Identify harness and wiring diagram
tasks.instructions: Confirm variant and modifications; use matching diagram, not generic wire colors.
tasks.reason: Wrong wiring can damage parts or cause fire.
tasks.expected: Harness identity and diagram source recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Harness identity and diagram source recorded.

tasks.title: Inspect wires, connectors and grounds
tasks.instructions: Check brittle insulation, corrosion, heat damage, splices, abrasion, grommets and grounds.
tasks.expected: Unsafe sections repaired/replaced.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Unsafe sections repaired/replaced.

tasks.title: Test continuity and shorts circuit by circuit
tasks.instructions: Isolate components and compare expected/measured result against exact diagram; resistance tests only on de-energized circuits.
tasks.expected: No unexplained opens/shorts; test log complete.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No unexplained opens/shorts; test log complete.

tasks.title: Test generator, rectifier and regulator
tasks.instructions: Use exact factory test conditions and limits; test before connecting sensitive electronics.
tasks.expected: Readings and conditions recorded against verified limits.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Readings and conditions recorded against verified limits.

tasks.title: Identify/test fitted ignition system
tasks.instructions: Confirm actual points/condensers or other hardware; inspect coils, caps, plugs and timing components.
tasks.expected: System identified, tests passed, timing source recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: System identified, tests passed, timing source recorded.

tasks.title: Test switches, lights, indicators, horn and gauges
tasks.instructions: Test circuits individually; verify grounds, bulb/load and controls.
tasks.expected: All required circuits pass.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All required circuits pass.

tasks.title: Check modern gauge/headlight compatibility if chosen
tasks.instructions: Check voltage/current, polarity, connectors, mounting, beam pattern and tach/speed signal requirements.
tasks.expected: Written compatibility review approved before purchase.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Written compatibility review approved before purchase.

tasks.title: Approve paint and finish decisions
tasks.instructions: Choose original vs custom and record colors, gloss, plating and budget before stripping.
tasks.expected: Decision approved and logged.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Decision approved and logged.

tasks.title: Mask machined/bearing/sealing surfaces
tasks.instructions: Identify areas that must not receive paint, blast media or chemicals; second-person check before processing.
tasks.expected: Masking plan independently checked.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Masking plan independently checked.

tasks.title: Refinish frame after structural approval
tasks.instructions: Use suitable process; preserve threads, bearing seats, grounds and identification marks.
tasks.reason: Finish must not conceal unresolved damage.
tasks.expected: Coverage/cure/masking inspected.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Coverage/cure/masking inspected.

tasks.title: Refinish tank, covers, fenders and trim
tasks.instructions: Repair rust/cracks and test fit before finish; observe full cure before fuel/assembly.
tasks.expected: Finish and fit approved; before/after photos filed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Finish and fit approved; before/after photos filed.

tasks.title: Clean/refinish engine cases safely
tasks.instructions: Protect oilways, bearing seats, gasket faces and threads; never blast assembled engine internals.
tasks.expected: Finish approved; oilways/mating faces rechecked.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Finish approved; oilways/mating faces rechecked.

tasks.title: Rebuild forks and steering
tasks.instructions: Use verified parts, fluid, torque and assembly procedure; record movement/leak check.
tasks.expected: Independent inspection passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Independent inspection passed.

tasks.title: Rebuild wheels, bearings and tires
tasks.instructions: Use correct spacers, bearing tools, tire fitment and retention procedure.
tasks.expected: Wheel checks and retention signed off.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Wheel checks and retention signed off.

tasks.title: Rebuild brake assemblies
tasks.instructions: Complete component inspection, hoses, pads and bleeding preparation.
tasks.reason: Brakes must pass before road use.
tasks.expected: Independent brake sign-off; no leaks/binding.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Independent brake sign-off; no leaks/binding.

tasks.title: Rebuild carburetors as a documented set
tasks.instructions: Record carb model, jets, passages, float/needle/seat, shafts and settings; use exact factory data.
tasks.reason: Wrong settings cause poor running and risk.
tasks.expected: All carbs documented, passages clear, settings sourced.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All carbs documented, passages clear, settings sourced.

tasks.title: Restore tank and fuel tap
tasks.instructions: Inspect corrosion, pinholes, seals, cap, filter and safe flow/leak test.
tasks.expected: Tank/tap pass leak and flow checks.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Tank/tap pass leak and flow checks.

tasks.title: Prepare intake and exhaust components
tasks.instructions: Inspect cracks, flange damage, blocked internals, mounts, and gaskets.
tasks.expected: Parts accepted/repaired/replaced.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Parts accepted/repaired/replaced.

tasks.title: Prepare refinished frame
tasks.instructions: Check cure, threads, bearing seats, ground points and masking before assembly.
tasks.expected: Assembly-readiness check passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Assembly-readiness check passed.

tasks.title: Install steering, swingarm, forks and shocks
tasks.instructions: Use correct spacers, lubrication, torque and adjustment from manual.
tasks.expected: Independent chassis check passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Independent chassis check passed.

tasks.title: Install wheels and brakes
tasks.instructions: Verify spacer order, orientation, retainers, routing, rotation and torque values.
tasks.expected: Second-person wheel and brake check passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Second-person wheel and brake check passed.

tasks.title: Install engine safely
tasks.instructions: Use rated lifting equipment; protect finish and verify mounts/spacers/fasteners.
tasks.reason: Reduces crush and frame damage risk.
tasks.expected: Mounts/torque values recorded and reviewed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Mounts/torque values recorded and reviewed.

tasks.title: Route harness after refinishing
tasks.instructions: Use verified routing, grommets, abrasion protection and strain relief; avoid heat/pinch/steering zones.
tasks.expected: Routing photos; continuity rechecked before battery.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Routing photos; continuity rechecked before battery.

tasks.title: Install controls, gauges, lights and cables
tasks.instructions: Verify routing, free play, connector fit, mounting and signals.
tasks.expected: Controls move freely and circuits pass.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Controls move freely and circuits pass.

tasks.title: Install intake, airbox, carbs and fuel lines
tasks.instructions: Use verified boots/clamps and route lines away from heat/moving parts; check throttle return.
tasks.reason: Prevents intake leaks and fuel hazards.
tasks.expected: Secure routing, throttle return; leak test scheduled.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Secure routing, throttle return; leak test scheduled.

tasks.title: Install exhaust system
tasks.instructions: Use verified gaskets/brackets/fasteners; check clearance from wires, hoses and bodywork.
tasks.expected: System secure and clearances checked.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: System secure and clearances checked.

tasks.title: Fill engine oil and verify level
tasks.instructions: Use oil grade/capacity and procedure from exact manual; record brand/quantity.
tasks.expected: Correct oil and level documented from source.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Correct oil and level documented from source.

tasks.title: Adjust throttle/clutch/control cables
tasks.instructions: Check lock-to-lock steering; no binding or unintended throttle opening.
tasks.expected: Throttle snaps shut at all steering positions.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Throttle snaps shut at all steering positions.

tasks.title: Test wiring before battery connection
tasks.instructions: Check polarity, fuse rating, continuity, shorts and grounds against exact diagram.
tasks.expected: Independent electrical review passed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Independent electrical review passed.

tasks.title: Perform static fuel leak test
tasks.instructions: Ventilate; remove ignition sources; inspect tank/tap/lines/bowls/overflow.
tasks.reason: Fuel leaks must be fixed before starting.
tasks.expected: Zero seepage/leaks and reviewer recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Zero seepage/leaks and reviewer recorded.

tasks.title: Verify fasteners and torque
tasks.instructions: Use location-specific manual values and source/page; second-person check critical retention.
tasks.expected: All critical fasteners recorded and signed; no guesses.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All critical fasteners recorded and signed; no guesses.

tasks.title: Complete formal pre-start checklist
tasks.instructions: Verify oil/lubrication, plugs/ignition state, fuel shutoff, tools removed, brakes, wiring, leaks and fire safety.
tasks.reason: Reduces injury and engine damage risk.
tasks.expected: Gate 12 passed and all critical systems signed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Gate 12 passed and all critical systems signed.

tasks.title: Prepare safe first-start area
tasks.instructions: Ventilate, secure bike, extinguisher ready, exhaust extraction, observer roles and stop signals agreed.
tasks.expected: First-start plan reviewed and signed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: First-start plan reviewed and signed.

tasks.title: Carry out model-specific first-start procedure
tasks.instructions: Follow manual and machine-shop/rebuilder instructions; do not guess break-in or heat-cycle procedures.
tasks.expected: Run observations logged; shutdown criteria understood.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Run observations logged; shutdown criteria understood.

tasks.title: Inspect leaks, noises, smoke and charging
tasks.instructions: Shut down for fuel leak, abnormal noise, smoke, lubrication concern or other fault.
tasks.reason: Stops early faults becoming major failures.
tasks.expected: No unresolved leak/noise/charging fault.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: No unresolved leak/noise/charging fault.

tasks.title: Synchronize carbs and set idle/mixture
tasks.instructions: Only after valve clearances, ignition, intake sealing and fuel quality are verified; use exact manual procedure.
tasks.reason: Carb adjustment cannot fix mechanical faults.
tasks.expected: Readings/settings recorded; stable running verified.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Readings/settings recorded; stable running verified.

tasks.title: Complete heat-cycle/post-run checks
tasks.instructions: Follow manual/rebuilder requirements; check leaks, oil level, specified fasteners and valve clearance only when required.
tasks.expected: Gate 14 passed; follow-up actions closed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Gate 14 passed; follow-up actions closed.

tasks.title: Independent inspection of brakes/tires/wheels/steering/suspension
tasks.instructions: Reviewer must not be sole person who did the work; record objective checks and source limits.
tasks.reason: Critical systems must pass before movement under power.
tasks.expected: All safety systems pass; no pending/failed critical check.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: All safety systems pass; no pending/failed critical check.

tasks.title: Verify lights, horn, controls and legal equipment
tasks.instructions: Confirm required equipment and local road-use requirements before public road use.
tasks.expected: Required equipment works and legal review recorded.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Required equipment works and legal review recorded.

tasks.title: Static and controlled low-speed test
tasks.instructions: Only after all safety gates pass; use safe legal controlled area, qualified rider and stop criteria.
tasks.expected: Findings recorded; no unresolved safety issue.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Findings recorded; no unresolved safety issue.

tasks.title: Inspect after initial operation
tasks.instructions: Check leaks, specified fasteners, chain, tires, brakes, controls and engine behavior.
tasks.expected: Follow-up passed; restrictions/intervals documented.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Follow-up passed; restrictions/intervals documented.

tasks.title: Reconcile inventory, receipts, labor and issues
tasks.instructions: Close unmatched invoices, duplicate IDs, unfiled evidence and open high-severity problems.
tasks.expected: Costs reconciled and evidence filed.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Costs reconciled and evidence filed.

tasks.title: Create maintenance schedule
tasks.instructions: Populate intervals from correct manual and rebuild instructions; do not guess intervals.
tasks.expected: Intervals sourced and assigned.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Intervals sourced and assigned.

tasks.title: Final handover and archive
tasks.instructions: Archive measurements, photos, receipts, manual references, decisions and safety approvals.
tasks.expected: Gate 16 passed; owner signs off.
tasks.inspectionCriteria: Gate 16 passed; owner signs off.

steps.title: Identify engine configuration
steps.procedure: Record casting marks, modifications, missing plugs/covers and evidence of water ingress.

steps.title: Clean for inspection
steps.procedure: Protect openings/oilways; use compatible cleaner and avoid introducing grit.
steps.acceptance: Clean enough to inspect without contamination.

steps.title: Disassemble only as required
steps.procedure: Follow manual sequence; photograph timing, shim, bearing and fastener locations; label all items.

steps.title: Inspect casting, journals, valves, guides and seats
steps.procedure: Record cracks, scoring, wear and dimensions; refer questionable parts to machine shop.

steps.title: Inspect cams, chain, tensioner and guides
steps.procedure: Inspect lobes/journals and chain components using factory criteria.
steps.acceptance: Verified limits met or replacements approved.

steps.title: Measure bore taper/out-of-round
steps.procedure: Measure each bore at prescribed heights and axes; record each reading.

steps.title: Inspect pistons, rings, grooves and pins
steps.procedure: Measure clearance/end gap per manual and keep each set paired by cylinder.
steps.acceptance: Repair scope approved before parts order.

steps.title: Inspect crankshaft, journals and bearings
steps.procedure: Measure dimensions/play and inspect scoring/discoloration; refer uncertain results to machine shop.
steps.acceptance: No internal wear accepted without measurement.

steps.title: Inspect pump, sump, pickup and oilways
steps.procedure: Remove debris and protect passages from abrasive media/lint.

steps.title: Inspect gears, forks, drum, basket and plates
steps.procedure: Inspect each gear/dog/fork and measure clutch wear per manual.

steps.title: Approve work after measurements
steps.procedure: Get written estimate; confirm parts availability and owner approval before machining.

steps.title: Verify engine bill of materials
steps.procedure: Check gaskets, seals, circlips, bearings, shims, fasteners and one-time-use items against fiche/manual.
steps.acceptance: All required parts present and fitment verified.

steps.title: Assemble lower end/transmission
steps.procedure: Follow exact sequence, clearances, sealant locations and verified torque values.

steps.title: Install pistons, cylinders and head
steps.procedure: Use verified ring orientation, gasket orientation, lubrication and torque sequence.

steps.title: Set timing and rotate engine by hand
steps.procedure: Use exact marks/tensioner procedure; stop if interference is felt.

steps.title: Adjust and record each valve
steps.procedure: Record clearance, shim and final clearance to exact manual limits.
steps.acceptance: All final clearances pass verified limits.

steps.title: Lubrication and engine pre-install checks
steps.procedure: Use model-specific priming method; verify seals, covers, plugs and rotation.

steps.title: Record carburetor markings
steps.procedure: Photograph bodies, tops, bowls, jets and linkage before teardown; confirm exact carb model.
steps.acceptance: Settings sourced from exact manual, not guessed.

steps.title: Inspect rust/corrosion/pinholes
steps.procedure: Use light/borescope and inspect seams/mounts before treatment.

steps.title: Clean/repair tank and test tap
steps.procedure: Use compatible process; protect paint; verify tap shutoff, filter, seals and flow safely.
steps.acceptance: No leaks; process and product documented.

steps.title: Disassemble one carb at a time
steps.procedure: Label jets, floats, needles, seats and mixture parts by carb; document mismatches.

steps.title: Clean jets/passages
steps.procedure: Use compatible cleaner; do not enlarge calibrated jets or use hard wire that changes orifices.
steps.acceptance: Passages clear without damage; markings recorded.

steps.title: Inspect float/needle/seat and height
steps.procedure: Measure in exact prescribed orientation and compare with verified manual.

steps.title: Inspect throttle shafts, springs and linkages
steps.procedure: Check free return, wear, shaft condition and synchronization hardware.

steps.title: Inspect boots, clamps, airbox and filter
steps.procedure: Check cracks/hardening; confirm original airbox configuration before tuning.

steps.title: Assemble carb set with verified settings
steps.procedure: Use correct jets, float settings, seals and baseline from exact model manual.
steps.acceptance: All settings sourced; no guessed jet sizes.

steps.title: Install carbs and test fuel system
steps.procedure: Route lines away from heat; check throttle return; leak test in ventilated area away from ignition sources.

steps.title: Synchronize and adjust idle/mixture
steps.procedure: Only after engine, valve clearances, ignition, intake sealing and fuel quality pass.
steps.acceptance: Stable running verified to factory procedure.

steps.title: Identify harness/diagram
steps.procedure: Confirm exact variant/market, harness markings and modifications; save diagram source.

steps.title: Inspect wires/connectors/grounds
steps.procedure: Look for brittle insulation, corrosion, heat damage, splices, abrasion and missing grommets.

steps.title: Test circuits and shorts
steps.procedure: Isolate components; compare expected/measured results to diagram. Resistance tests only when de-energized.

steps.title: Verify battery polarity, main fuse and grounds
steps.procedure: Use exact battery/fuse information; never oversize a fuse to stop it blowing.

steps.title: Test starter motor, relay and cables
steps.procedure: Use safe secure bench setup if testing motor; inspect high-current connections.

steps.title: Test generator/rectifier/regulator
steps.procedure: Use exact RPM/load and limits; test before connecting sensitive electronics.

steps.title: Identify and test fitted ignition
steps.procedure: Confirm points/condensers or modified system; test coils, caps, plugs and timing components.

steps.title: Test lamps, switches, horn and gauges
steps.procedure: Check each circuit; aftermarket parts require voltage/current/polarity/mounting/beam/signal compatibility review.
steps.acceptance: Required equipment functions; fitment evidence saved.

steps.title: Route harness after refinishing
steps.procedure: Use verified routing, grommets and abrasion protection; avoid heat, pinch, steering and suspension zones.
steps.acceptance: No chafe points; continuity rechecked before battery.

steps.title: Pre-battery electrical review
steps.procedure: Check polarity, fuse sizing, grounds, continuity and shorts; independent reviewer signs.
steps.acceptance: Electrical gate passed before battery connection.

steps.title: Inspect structural condition
steps.procedure: Document cracks, bends, corrosion and prior repairs; specialist assessment for suspected damage.

steps.title: Inspect pivot/bushings
steps.procedure: Check wear, corrosion, play, free movement and alignment.

steps.title: Inspect/rebuild bearings
steps.procedure: Check races, fit, preload, smooth movement and play.

steps.title: Inspect tubes, seals and internals
steps.procedure: Measure straightness/wear and inspect seal travel; rebuild with verified parts/specs.

steps.title: Inspect shocks/mounts
steps.procedure: Check leaks, damping, springs, mounting eyes and secure fit.

steps.title: Identify wheel type and inspect rims/hubs
steps.procedure: Check cracks, corrosion, spokes if applicable, bearing seats and runout.
steps.acceptance: Verified limits met or specialist repair approved.

steps.title: Inspect/replace wheel bearings/seals
steps.procedure: Confirm spacer order and bearing type from matching fiche; use proper tools.

steps.title: Verify tire fitment and condition
steps.procedure: Check size, load/speed rating, age, cracks, rim/tube compatibility and pressure source.

steps.title: Inspect/measure discs or drums
steps.procedure: Confirm actual brake design; measure wear/runout to manual limits.
steps.acceptance: All components within verified limits or replaced.

steps.title: Rebuild master cylinders/calipers
steps.procedure: Inspect bores, pistons, seals, slides and hoses; replace damaged parts.
steps.acceptance: No damaged bore or seized component.

steps.title: Install hoses, bleed and test
steps.procedure: Use correct fluid/procedure; check routing at full steering movement.
steps.acceptance: Firm controls, no leaks, independent sign-off.

steps.title: Inspect chain/sprockets
steps.procedure: Check wear, stiff links, teeth, alignment and adjustment to verified procedure.

steps.title: Verify chassis fasteners and retention
steps.procedure: Record axle, steering, suspension and brake fastener values with source/page; second-person check.
